hero.title: DataTable Playground
hero.description: All shared DataTable components — DataTableServer, DataTableStatic, and DataTablePlain — with a live interactive demo, column helper catalog, and copy-ready usage examples.

helper.description: Creates a fresh typed ColumnHelper per call — avoids singleton-mutation bugs. Auto-sets meta.isCustomCell = true when a cell renderer is provided.

accessor.description: Raw accessor column. Omit cell to use the default renderValue path; provide cell for custom rendering (isCustomCell set automatically).

select.description: Checkbox column. Header shows Select All only when enableMultiRowSelection is true.

actions.description: Trigger-only 3-dot dropdown. Pass render for menu items; omit for a placeholder empty menu while the feature is being built.

status.description: Badge column. status(row) returns the display label. statusClassName(row) is optional — add Tailwind classes for custom badge colors.

tick.description: CircleCheck / CircleX icon. getTicked(row) overrides the default !!getValue() boolean check.

date.description: Formats value with formatDate(). Renders — when value is null or undefined. Default value must be a Date object.

meta.align: Text alignment applied to both the header cell and every data cell in this column.
meta.className: Extra Tailwind classes appended to every data cell in this column.
meta.headerClassName: Extra Tailwind classes appended only to the header cell.
meta.sticky: Pins the column to the left or right edge. Offset is computed from actual DOM widths via useLayoutEffect — no manual size config needed.

server.title: Server-side setup
server.description: DataTableServer manages pagination, search, filter, and sort state and fires onChangeListRequest whenever any of them change. Use placeholderData to keep previous data visible while fetching.

client.title: Client-side (static data)
client.description: DataTableStatic handles filtering, sorting, and optional pagination entirely client-side. No API call needed — pass the data array directly.

columns.title: Column definitions
columns.description: Use getColumnHelper() for a fresh typed helper. Columns with a cell prop get meta.isCustomCell = true automatically — the table renderer uses flexRender instead of renderValue.

factories.title: Column factories
factories.description: createStatusColumn, createTickColumn, and createDateColumn wrap an accessor with a typed cell renderer and sensible defaults. Pass extra ColumnDef props via the spread rest.

filters.title: Faceted filters
filters.description: Define filterFields with an id that matches the API filter field name and an options array. Pass to either DataTableServer or DataTableStatic.

sticky.title: Sticky columns
sticky.description: Set meta.sticky on any column definition. createSelectColumn defaults to sticky: left and createActionsColumn to sticky: right. The DataTable reads meta.sticky automatically — no extra prop needed.

actionsRender.title: actionsRender — accessing selected rows
actionsRender.description: actionsRender receives the table instance and isLoading flag. Use table.getSelectedRowModel() to read selected rows and enable or disable bulk actions.

tableMeta.title: TableMeta — passing callbacks into cells
tableMeta.description: Use meta to inject router or mutation callbacks into cell renderers so columns stay portable and don't close over stale props.

plain.title: Plain table (DataTablePlain)
plain.description: DataTablePlain is for sub-tables inside forms or detail views. No toolbar, no pagination — supports custom cell renderers (inline inputs, buttons) and an optional footer row.

plain.whenDescription: Use DataTablePlain when you need a simple embedded table without toolbar features. It uses the same ui/table components as DataTableServer and DataTableStatic — styling is always consistent.
